_meta.description: Carta OAuth 2.0 client-credentials RE-MINT. Carta has NO refresh-token grant — access tokens expire hourly and are re-minted by re-running the client_credentials grant with HTTP Basic client auth (base64(client_id:client_secret)) and the REQUIRED space-delimited `scope` form field. No refresh_token is returned. The stored refresh_secret_ref therefore holds the client-credentials SECRET (not an OAuth refresh token). Doc-derived; tokens are placeholders. NOTE: the doc example sends grant_type=CLIENT_CREDENTIALS (uppercase); our exchange sends the RFC-6749 lowercase value — verify on the first real (partner-gated) exchange.
_meta.source: doc:https://docs.carta.com/carta/docs/client-credentials-flow (POST https://login.app.carta.com/o/access_token/ — trailing slash; Basic auth header; form scope + grant_type; response access_token/expires_in/scope/token_type; tokens ~1h, NO refresh grant)
